subject: Renewal: Bridge to Flexible Commit with Graceband & Triggered Burst
messages:
From: Rajiv Menon <rajiv@stellarhealth.com>
To: markus_klein@redwoodai.com
Cc: Procurement <procurement@stellarhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 22 Jul 2028 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal window + requested flexibility for 2029

Hi Markus,

Thanks again for the renewal overview last week. We're close on the numbers but need a structure change to reduce near-term cash impact and preserve scale flexibility. High level ask: convert the proposed annual committed spend into a 24-month mix where the first 6 months are a lower "onramp" (50% of annual commit), months 7-18 ramp to 120% of baseline, and months 19-24 are a soft ramp-down. We also want an auto-renew opt-in, but with a 30-day notice clause.

Two specific asks:
- A "graceband" that allows 15% monthly overage without penalty during the onramp window.
- A triggered burst pool that we can call at predefined SLAs (we'll buy extra capacity at pre-agreed uplift rates).

Can you send a proposed amendment and a short mutual action plan? Procurement/Legal will review after we get your proposal.

Regards,
Rajiv
VP Product & Cloud Ops
StellarHealth

[Attachment: renewal-needs-stellar-0722.pdf (summary)]

From: markus_klein@redwoodai.com
To: Rajiv Menon <rajiv@stellarhealth.com>
Cc: camila_reyes@redwoodai.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodai.com
Date: Mon, 25 Jul 2028 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal window + requested flexibility for 2029

Rajiv — thanks for the clear asks. We're happy to structure a plan that balances your cash profile and our capacity planning. Draft approach I discussed with GTM and Legal:

1) Term: 24 months, effective 2029-01-01.
2) Onramp (months 1-6): committed baseline at 50% of prior-year burn; graceband +15% overage allowance with no surcharge.
3) Main ramp (months 7-18): scheduled increase to 120% of baseline; usage overage billed at standard overage rates.
4) Soft ramp-down (months 19-24): baseline reduces to 80% to provide flexibility.
5) Triggered burst: pre-purchased burst credits available at pre-negotiated uplift (x1.6 per-token). Activation via API + email notice; 24-hour pre-notice for scheduled events, immediate activation for critical events with a 4-hour SLA.
6) Auto-renew: Opt-in checkbox with 30-day cancellation window; we can add an annual price escalation cap if you prefer.

I'll attach a short mutual action plan and a clean amendment for Procurement to review. Camila (CS) will coordinate the MOP and onboarding cadence; Karthik (pricing) will loop in final uplift numbers.

Next step: I'll send the amendment v1 and MAP by EOD tomorrow. Sound good?

—Markus
Director, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: proposed-amendment-stellar-0725.pdf (stub)]

From: camila_reyes@redwoodai.com
To: markus_klein@redwoodai.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodai.com
Date: Tue, 26 Jul 2028 11:42:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Notes on graceband and burst ops (for amendment)

Markus / Karthik — quick internal note before we finalize wording for Legal:

- Graceband: recommend defining it as a rolling 30-day window where up to 15% over baseline is considered "buffer" and won't count against usage-based true-ups. Clarify that persistent >15% will trigger review and possible re-baselining (not immediate penalty).
- Burst pool: suggest two purchase options: (A) banked credits (prepay) or (B) on-demand at the uplift rate with minimum 12-hour notice. Stellar asked for immediate activation for emergencies — we should allow it but require a post-event reconciliation and minimum charge.
- Auto-renew: we should cap annual increase at 5% unless Stellar requests a price reset tied to an index.

I'll prepare language snippets for the amendment. Also creating a short mutual-action-plan spreadsheet with milestone owners (onboarding, SSO, billing, transit tests).

Camila
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Procurement <procurement@stellarhealth.com>

Cc: Rajiv Menon <rajiv@stellarhealth.com>, Legal <legal@stellarhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 28 Jul 2028 10:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal window + requested flexibility for 2029 — contract points

Hi Markus / Camila,

Thanks for the draft outline. A few procurement/legal items we'll need in the amendment:
- Precise definition of "graceband" and the 30-day rolling window language.
- Clear activation procedure for Triggered Burst (API call + signed PO or SOW) and who has authority to activate.
- SLA for burst activation, and credits/refunds if we hit degraded performance.
- Data residency and audit log access during burst events (SOC2 scope).
- Confirmation that auto-renew will not auto-enroll new sub-products and that the 30-day notice can be provided by designated contacts only.

Also, please include a short cancellation carve-out if our volume drops >40% for a sustained 90-day period — we need an escape clause.

Procurement will review your amendment when you send v1.

Thanks,
Maya Patel
Head of Procurement
StellarHealth

From: markus_klein@redwoodai.com

Date: Mon, 30 Jul 2028 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal window + requested flexibility for 2029 — amendment v1 attached

Maya / Rajiv — attached is Amendment v1 plus the mutual action plan. Highlights against your asks:

- Graceband defined as rolling 30-day window; up to 15% tolerated without surcharge. Re-baselining clause after 60 days of sustained >15% usage included.
- Triggered Burst: two options (banked credits or on-demand). Activation requires API call and one authorized contact's written confirmation; emergency activation allowed via phone + email with post-event reconciliation. SLAs outlined (4-hour initiation target for emergencies, 24-hour for scheduled).
- Audit logs and SOC2 access: we will provide read-only logs and a quarterly audit extract.
- Auto-renew: explicit opt-in; limited to included products. 30-day notice must come from pre-declared contacts. Price increase cap set at 5% annually.
- Cancellation carve-out: included for sustained >40% drop for 90 consecutive days, with a 60-day cure period.

Attachments: Amendment_v1_Stellar_0729.pdf, MAP_Stellar_0729.xlsx

Next steps: if Procurement/Legal are comfortable, we can move to redlines. Camila will schedule a 30-minute alignment call with your Legal to walk through the trigger/burst wording.

Appreciate the collaboration — happy to iterate quickly.

Best,
Markus Klein
Director, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
